ModbusCmd.Title: I_DC_Power_RAW
ModbusCmd.HintText:
DC Power = PV Production + Battery Power (1&2) Raw value, must be converted using SF!
Formula: (RAW*10^SF)/1000 = DC Power in kW

ModbusCmd.Title: I_Status
ModbusCmd.HintText: 1 = Off 2 = Sleeping (auto-shutdown) – Night mode 3 = Grid Monitoring/wake-up 4 = Inverter is ON and producing power 5 = Production (curtailed) 6 = Shutting down 7 = Fault 8 = Maintenance/setup

ModbusCmd.Title: M_AC_Power_RAW
ModbusCmd.HintText:
AC Power of connected Meter. Raw value, needs to be converted using Scaling Factor (SF)
Formula: (RAW*10^SF)/1000 = Meter AC Power in kW

ModbusCmd.Title: M_AC_Power_SF
ModbusCmd.HintText: Scaling factor for connected meters raw AC_Power value.

ModbusCmd.Title: M_Exported_Energy_RAW
ModbusCmd.HintText:
Raw exported energy value of connected meter. Needs to be converted to kWh using the meters energy scaling factor (M_Energy_SF).
Formula: (RAW*10^SF)/1000 = Exported Energy in kWh

ModbusCmd.Title: M_Imported_Energy_RAW
ModbusCmd.HintText:
Raw imported energy value of connected meter. Needs to be converted to kWh using the meters energy scaling factor (M_Energy_SF).
Formula: (RAW*10^SF)/1000 = Imported Energy in kWh

ModbusCmd.Title: M_Energy_SF
ModbusCmd.HintText: Scaling factor for connected meters raw energy values.

ModbusCmd.Title: B1_State_of_Energy
ModbusCmd.HintText: State of Energy of Battery1 in % (0-100)

ModbusCmd.Title: B1_Instantaneous_Power
ModbusCmd.HintText: Power of Battery1 in kW Positive = Charging Negative = Discharging

ModbusCmd.Title: B2_State_of_Energy
ModbusCmd.HintText: State of Energy of Battery1 in % (0-100)

ModbusCmd.Title: B2_Instantaneus_Power
ModbusCmd.HintText: Power of Battery2 in kW Positive = Charging Negative = Discharging
